product_one_liner.value: Luminance is an AI-powered contract-intelligence platform that helps legal teams and other enterprise departments draft, negotiate, analyze and manage contracts.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage names legal and other enterprise departments as audiences and describes drafting, negotiation, analysis and end-to-end contract workflows. Source: https://www.luminance.com/

pricing_page.notes: The homepage directs visitors to a demo and has no pricing link. A pricing review checked on August 31, 2026 explicitly reports no public pricing page or self-service tiers. Sources: https://www.luminance.com/ and https://legalizeai.com/blog/luminance-pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Staples appears in a customer story and Yokogawa appears on the customer-stories page. Sources: https://www.luminance.com/customers/luminance-adds-value-speeds-up-processes-and-eliminates-risk and https://www.luminance.com/customers | named_customers.0: The customer story describes Staples’ use of Luminance: https://www.luminance.com/customers/luminance-adds-value-speeds-up-processes-and-eliminates-risk | named_customers.1: Yokogawa is named on Luminance’s customer-stories page: https://www.luminance.com/customers

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly lists a company size of 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/luminancetech

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s LinkedIn profile and Forbes identify Cambridge as headquarters. Some other profiles list London, so the city is reported with reduced confidence. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/luminancetech and http://forbes.com/companies/luminance | hq_country: The company’s LinkedIn profile identifies its country as the United Kingdom. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/luminancetech

founded_year.notes: The company states that it was founded in 2015. Source: http://luminance.com/about

eng_blog.notes: The public index is a product, insights and recruitment-oriented blog. Checked engineering-profile articles are marketing or hiring pieces rather than evidence of a qualifying engineering blog with two build-oriented technical posts. This classification is interpretive. Sources: https://www.luminance.com/blog and https://www.luminance.com/resources/blog/from-ideas-to-innovation-qa-with-joe-danbury-ai-product-engineer/

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains substantive REST API documentation, OAuth2 authentication guidance and numerous documented endpoints, including folder access and document uploads. Source: https://api.luminance.com/swagger-docsv150

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Machine Learning Research Engineer posting is marked confirmed live within the last 24 hours in the same-day verified evidence. Source: https://simplify.jobs/p/7585e74f-2916-4691-b493-97166fd23c38/Machine-Learning-Research-Engineer

model_provider.value: Luminance’s proprietary Luna Crescent model; OpenAI.
model_provider.notes: The technology page identifies the proprietary Luna Crescent model, while the Trust Center names OpenAI as a generative-model provider. Sources: https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology and https://trust.luminance.com/

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Luminance’s Trust Center explicitly lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR. Source: https://trust.luminance.com/ | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly lists SOC 2 Type II: https://trust.luminance.com/ | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly lists ISO 27001:2022: https://trust.luminance.com/ | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly lists GDPR: https://trust.luminance.com/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding-history entry and the company’s announcement both identify the round as Series C. Source: https://www.luminance.com/press-releases/luminance-raises-75-million-in-series-c-funding-round-led-by-point72-private-investments | funding_date: The latest recorded round and the visible original company-announcement date are February 18, 2025, formatted as 2025-02. Source: https://www.luminance.com/press-releases/luminance-raises-75-million-in-series-c-funding-round-led-by-point72-private-investments | funding_amount_usd: The funding history identifies Series C as the latest round; the company’s announcement gives its disclosed amount as $75 million, equivalent to USD 75,000,000. Source: https://www.luminance.com/press-releases/luminance-raises-75-million-in-series-c-funding-round-led-by-point72-private-investments

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round occurred on February 18, 2025, before the requested 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025. Source: https://www.luminance.com/press-releases/luminance-raises-75-million-in-series-c-funding-round-led-by-point72-private-investments

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Development Representative posting is marked confirmed live within the last 24 hours in the same-day verified evidence. Source: https://simplify.jobs/p/1d1c6a1e-3b8e-4b76-9ab9-390df9c12b12/Business-Development-Representative

launched_6mo.notes: Luminance unveiled its Luna Crescent vertical AI model on June 19, 2026, within the six months preceding November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.luminance.com/press-releases/luminance-unveils-luna-crescent-the-vertical-ai-model-powering-contract-intelligence-with-market-leading-accuracy-and-speed

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luminance announced Don Riddick’s appointment as its new Chief Legal Officer on September 29, 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://www.luminance.com/press-releases/luminance-appoints-don-riddick-as-chief-legal-officer
